main_content:
The Blount Chamber, a nonpartisan organization, welcomes you to the voters' resource page for Blount County elections. Here, you can view the candidates running for office during August 6 election. This includes federal/state primary for governor, U.S. Senator, U.S. House of Representatives, State Executive Committeeman. Municipal primary for Alcoa and Maryville City School Board. General election for all county offices and commission along with county school board districts 1, 3, 5, 7. Municipal election for Friendsville and Townsend City Commissions.

In addition, you'll find information on registering to vote, important dates, finding your precinct and district and other information relating to Blount County elections in 2026.

Take time to learn about the candidates and remember to exercise your right to vote.

important_dates.description: Last day to register to vote for the August 6 election
